mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (user_id, token_hash, session_id, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{sessionId}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, session_id, expires_at, revoked_at, revoke_reason, created_at FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
